title: SoakLiveProbe
description: A public-safe description of an optional runtime check against a live Redis/AMR instance used to confirm a source fact empirically. Encodes the abstract command/check and expected signal only. The concrete endpoint, credentials, and effective config are resolved via a source-provider-locator into the gitignored eval-runs tree.

check.description: Public-safe command or inspection performed (e.g. 'CLUSTER INFO', 'CONFIG GET maxmemory-policy'). No endpoints or credentials.

expected_signal.description: Abstract expectation the probe verifies (e.g. 'cluster_enabled:1', 'CROSSSLOT error on multi-key op across slots').

destructive.description: True if the probe mutates state; runners must gate destructive probes.

isolation.description: Concurrency isolation for this probe. Destructive probes must not be read-only.

cohort_ref.description: Optional execution cohort that governs how this probe is scheduled and leased.
